results.cause: Likely cause: the top-level "Trades" span in the IR Swap navigation does not navigate on click; in both windows the Trades span clicks are followed by no navigation or overlay, and the screen only changes after a "menuitem" click (S14f12e28 event 56, S1ecbb600 event 88), which suggests Trades opens a submenu whose open state is not visibly signalled.
results.fix: Fix: In the IR Swap top navigation, make the "Trades" span/button either navigate directly on click or show a clear open state (aria-expanded and a highlighted, visibly open submenu) so the click on "Trades" produces a visible change, instead of relying on the user to click a menuitem afterwards.

results.cause: Likely cause: on the cap / floor screen, each Save click (323, 370, 418) is followed by a visible error (app:54, app:61, app:68) and then an OK dismissal (336, 383), after which the user edits Notional (348, 395) and clicks Save again, so the validation feedback does not appear to point to a field the user can fix in place.
results.fix: Fix: On the cap / floor screen, make the Save button's validation handling show the error inline beside the invalid field (and focus that field) instead of a blocking message that needs the OK click, so the Notional correction and re-save happen without the dismiss step.

results.cause: Likely cause: after each Save on the cap / floor screen, a visible error (app:36, app:43, app:50) appears, the user dismisses it with OK (328, 420), and then edits Notional (340, 387) before clicking Save again (362, 407), so the captured events suggest the error does not make the failing input clear enough to fix in one pass.
results.fix: Fix: On the cap / floor screen, change the Save click handler's validation failure path so it marks each invalid field with an inline message and moves focus to the first invalid field, instead of only showing the generic error dialog that is closed with the OK button.

results.cause: Likely cause: on the cap / floor screen, clicking Save shows an overlay and then a visible error, and after the user dismisses it with OK the user returns to the Notional field, edits it, and clicks Save again, which repeats in each Save cycle within session S6baba239.
results.fix: Fix: On the cap / floor screen, change the Save click handler so that a validation failure shows its message inline next to the Notional input and moves focus to that input, instead of a blocking overlay that must be dismissed with OK before the field can be corrected.
